0022600016.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-4, 12th in the East) are on a three-game losing streak and visit the Boston Celtics (3-1, 3rd in the East), who have won three straight and are 3-0 at home. In the 2026-27 season series the Bulls trail 0-1 after a 134-99 loss in Boston on October 26, 2026, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), and Jalen Smith (finger) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are listed as day-to-day, while Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness).
